questions.question: Describe the four sections of the D&T NEA and what each must include.
questions.correctAnswer: Section 1 - Investigating: research, user needs, existing products, design brief and specification. Section 2 - Designing: initial ideas (annotated sketches), development, modelling, final design. Section 3 - Making: step-by-step manufacture with photographic evidence, quality control, safety. questions.question: Explain why it is important to evaluate the final prototype against the original specification.
questions.correctAnswer: The specification is the benchmark the product was designed to meet - if you do not test against it, you cannot prove the product succeeds. Each specification point should have: a test method, the result, and a conclusion (met/not met/partially met). This directly addresses AO4 (Analysing and Evaluating) worth 15%.

questions.question: A student has spent 15 hours on research and has only 5 hours left for making and evaluation. What advice would you give?
questions.correctAnswer: Stop researching immediately - you have enough data to design. Move to Section 2: generate 3-4 quick concept sketches with annotations, select the best idea, develop it. Section 3: prioritise key functional elements - the prototype needs to work, not be perfect. Section 4: test against specification, suggest two specific improvements.
